commitResults.messageTitle: A-Enums: Use enum for command types
Level-8: Parse and format task dates

commitResults.messageBody:
The project lacks persistent instructions for Java style, Git history, and UI regression testing.

Add the project-specific skills and package the Java sources so future refactors follow a consistent baseline.

Gary mixes command handling with console input and output, which makes the application flow difficult to follow.

Move all terminal interactions into Ui so Gary can focus on coordinating chatbot behavior.

Gary interprets command syntax, task details, dates, and task numbers in addition to coordinating application behavior.

Move input interpretation into Parser so command handling has one focused source of validation rules.

Gary owns the task collection and performs every mutation, which exposes collection details throughout the command loop.

Move task storage and mutations into TaskList and keep Gary focused on coordinating the parser, UI, storage, and task list.

All classes sit in one package despite having distinct responsibilities.

Move each responsibility into a focused subpackage.

Keep src/main/java as the source root.

The project needs a reproducible build and application launcher.

Merge the provided Gradle wrapper and build configuration into master.

The provided build targets the template's Duke class and artifact name.

Point the application plugin at Gary.

Name the packaged artifact gary.jar to match the chatbot.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit coverage for core behavior
commitResults.messageBody:
Core behavior has no automated regression coverage.

Add focused tests for commands, task state, and storage.

Document the 50% high-value coverage target for future changes.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadoc for task manager API
commitResults.messageBody:
The public API lacks documentation of its purpose and behavior.

Document all production classes and their exposed operations so that callers
can understand their contracts without reading implementation details.

The production and test classes use the default package and contain layout
that does not satisfy the project's required Java standard.

Organize related classes into lower-case packages, align the tests with their
production packages, and normalize wrapping and switch indentation.

Java changes need a durable project rule so future contributions continue
to follow the course standard.

Add a project skill containing the required checks and make its use mandatory
in the repository agent guidance.

Commit quality depends on applying the course conventions consistently
after this increment.

Add a focused Git-standard skill and require agents to load it before creating
branches, commits, merges, or tags.

Visual reviews require the diff generator to be available to every clone of
the project rather than only in this working copy.

Track the existing project skill and its self-contained HTML generator.

commitResults.messageTitle: Find command: Add task description search
commitResults.messageBody:
Users cannot retrieve tasks by description without reading the entire list.

Add a case-insensitive find command that retains original task numbers.
Reject empty keywords, and cover command recognition and keyword matching in
JUnit.

Bring the completed API documentation into the integration branch while
preserving the parallel feature branch in history.

Integrate the package and coding-standard work together with the reusable
project skills that keep future Java and Git changes compliant.
